sukikirai.title: Like or Dislike
sukikirai.subtitle: Voice-actress like / dislike board — results unlock after you vote
sukikirai.intro: Vote “like” or “dislike” on the voice actresses in our roster — the red / blue split and everyone's comments unlock once you vote.
sukikirai.guide: Up to 5 votes per person per day. Switching sides keeps the count; tomorrow you can add more.

stats.locked: Vote to see the split and comments

sukikirai.searchPlaceholder: Name, Japanese name, romaji or a signature role

vote.hint: Pick a side and the red / blue split plus everyone's comments unlock.
vote.mine: You voted “{{choice}}”: {{votes}} / {{limit}} votes today ({{total}} in total), {{remaining}} vote(s) left today. Click the same side for another vote, the other side to switch.
vote.full: Today's {{limit}} votes are in ({{choice}}, {{total}} in total). Click the other side to switch — the count stays, and you can add more tomorrow.

sukikirai.emptyDay: Nobody has voted yet — be the first and pick someone.
sukikirai.emptyRange: No votes in this period yet.
sukikirai.eggHint: A hidden option unlocked by lifetime votes — easter-egg entries stay hidden by default

reasons.title: Reason (optional)
reasons.hint: Pick one reason — you can switch or remove it later. Skipping is fine too.
reasons.none: You have not picked a reason yet.

like.vibe: No idea why, I just do

dislike.vibe: No idea why, I just don't

detail.notFound: This voice actress is not in the roster.

result.lockedHint: So the numbers cannot sway your choice, the split and comments stay locked until you vote.

comments.title: Comments
comments.guide: Sign in and vote first (up to {{count}} characters).
comments.comingSoon: Comments are being prepared — check the split for now.
comments.placeholder: Why do you like / dislike this voice actress?
comments.rejected: That text was blocked automatically. Please rephrase and try again.
comments.needVote: You need to vote before commenting.
comments.loginRequired: Sign in to post a comment

sukikirai.footnote: {{count}} voice actresses in the roster; the board ranks by total votes.
